verdict.rationale: Postman documents Agent Mode as able to "add tests to requests" and "update tests" using natural language. This is AI generating test assertions for an endpoint inside the product. Postbot is also documented as a first-party AI feature with usage limits and a paid add-on. missing for 10: explicit documentation that tests are generated from an API spec or from captured responses, detail on what kinds of assertions are produced, and independent or hands-on corroboration of test-generation quality.
